summary: A fixed hand-2 production model adds line-position and preceding-edge spelling to established copy/template components, with synthetic controls and three prespecified public ablations.

protocol.selection: The full model and all settings are frozen before loading manuscript pages. No component, order, window, scope or template size is selected using public evaluation outcomes.
protocol.controls_first: Independent synthetic pages with either a planted preceding-edge dependency or a planted line-position dependency. Compare an order-3 letter model with the corresponding trusted context-spelling component added. Match nulls by shuffling words within each synthetic page while preserving its multiset and line lengths.
protocol.synthetic_vocabulary: Four-glyph words: first and last glyph from a/o, two middle glyphs from l/r. Boundary control sets first glyph to previous word's final glyph; position control uses a initially and o finally, random first glyph otherwise.
protocol.primary: Run python -X utf8 -m vs experiment on the unchanged full model, using the default public practice split.
protocol.weights: Use existing models.fit_weights EM for each variant: fixed seed 7, components trained on half of training pages and weights fitted on the other half, 15 iterations. Evaluation pages never fit weights.
protocol.report: Report every prespecified variant, weights and word count; do not choose a winning variant for submission. The full model is submitted even if an ablation predicts better.
protocol.limits: Synthetic checks establish basic sensitivity, not uniform power or a calibrated manuscript significance test. Scores condition on supplied layout and observed previous words. A code-length gain does not prove a historical mechanism, absence of language or decipherment. This model submission is distinct from a daily generator attack against the fact battery.

"""Frozen production-model comparison, with synthetic sensitivity controls first."""
from collections import Counter
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from random import Random
import subprocess
import sys

here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = here / "voynich-swarm"
os.chdir(repo)
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo))
from vs import corpus, models
from vs.fetch import verify
from vs.ivtff import Line, Page

directory = repo / "experiments/M-G/Pavlenko77"
frozen = json.loads((directory / "model.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
envelope = json.loads((directory / "experiment.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
canonical = lambda d: json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
frozen_hash = hashlib.sha256(canonical(frozen)).hexdigest()
report = {"source_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], encoding="utf-8").strip(),
          "model_canonical_sha256": frozen_hash, "protocol": envelope["protocol"], "controls": {}, "practice": {}}


def save():
    (here / "hand2_context_results.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def pages(kind, count, seed, prefix):
    rng = Random(seed)
    result = []
    for index in range(count):
        pid = prefix + str(index)
        p = Page(pid, index, {"I": "H", "L": "B", "H": "2"})
        prev = rng.choice("ao")
        for ln in range(50):
            words = []
            for pos in range(8):
                if kind == "boundary":
                    first = prev
                else:
                    first = "a" if pos == 0 else "o" if pos == 7 else rng.choice("ao")
                w = first + rng.choice("lr") + rng.choice("lr") + rng.choice("ao")
                words.append(w)
                prev = w[-1]
            p.lines.append(Line(f"{pid}.{ln}", pid, ln, "P", "0", words, ln == 0, False))
        result.append(p)
    return result


def shuffled(pages, seed):
    rng = Random(seed)
    result = copy.deepcopy(pages)
    for original, p in zip(pages, result):
        words = [w for line in p.lines for w in line.words]
        original_counts = Counter(words)
        rng.shuffle(words)
        index = 0
        for line in p.lines:
            n = len(line.words)
            line.words = words[index:index+n]
            index += n
        assert Counter(w for line in p.lines for w in line.words) == original_counts
        assert [len(line.words) for line in p.lines] == [len(line.words) for line in original.lines]
    return result


def control(kind):
    tr = pages(kind, 10, 14040, "synthetic-train-")
    ev = pages(kind, 4, 14041, "synthetic-eval-")
    plain = {"components": [{"type": "letters", "order": 3}], "weights": "fit"}
    contextual = {"components": plain["components"] + [{"type": kind + "_letters", "order": 3}], "weights": "fit"}
    result = {}
    for label, train, evaluation in (("planted", tr, ev),
                                      ("matched_null", shuffled(tr, 14042), shuffled(ev, 14043))):
        baseline = models.evaluate(plain, train, evaluation)
        candidate = models.evaluate(contextual, train, evaluation)
        result[label] = {"baseline": baseline, "contextual": candidate,
                         "gain_bits_per_word": round(baseline["bits_per_word"] - candidate["bits_per_word"], 4)}
    return result


verify()
for kind in ("boundary", "position"):
    result = control(kind)
    report["controls"][kind] = result
    save()
    print(json.dumps({"control": kind, "results": result}), flush=True)
    threshold = .4 if kind == "boundary" else .05
    if result["planted"]["gain_bits_per_word"] < threshold or result["matched_null"]["gain_bits_per_word"] > .05:
        raise SystemExit("A frozen illustrative control failed; manuscript comparison not started.")

print("Synthetic controls passed; running the official full-model practice advisory.", flush=True)
completed = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-X", "utf8", "-m", "vs", "experiment", str(directory)],
                           cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", check=True)
print(completed.stdout, end="", flush=True)
full, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(completed.stdout.lstrip())
report["practice"]["full"] = full
report["official_advisory_stdout"] = completed.stdout
assert hashlib.sha256(canonical(json.loads((directory / "model.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))).hexdigest() == frozen_hash
save()

train, evaluation = corpus.split_pages("practice")
report["scope"] = {"hand": "2", "training_pages": len(models.scoped(train, frozen["scope"])),
                   "evaluation_pages": len(models.scoped(evaluation, frozen["scope"]))}
for label, removed in (("without_boundary_letters", {"boundary_letters"}),
                       ("without_position_letters", {"position_letters"}),
                       ("without_both_context_spellers", {"boundary_letters", "position_letters"})):
    ablated = copy.deepcopy(frozen)
    ablated["components"] = [c for c in frozen["components"] if c["type"] not in removed]
    result = models.evaluate(ablated, train, evaluation)
    report["practice"][label] = result
    save()
    print(json.dumps({"ablation": label, "results": result}), flush=True)
print("All frozen variants completed; the submitted full model remains unchanged.", flush=True)
